integrity: The proof uses the source's blow-up description and cohomology ranks, the classical Enriques numerical lattice, and an explicit Gysin self-intersection calculation. The bundled script checks only the resulting finite Gram matrix and does not replace the theoretical proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement determines only the free middle cup-product lattice. It does not determine the torsion linking form, the complete integral cohomology ring, characteristic classes, or the diffeomorphism type.
title: The free middle lattice of Tufo's Enriques Fano host is \(I_{11,2}\)
